main_text.l: Aristotele adduɆta non valet nili in
quin enim omnia in mundo forent sibi

l.i: veniens esse ut homines caeteraque perfecta

main_text.l: animalia sponte oriantur. Idque de ho-
pe homo perfectissimum quid est in
enit, ut perfectissimo modo oriatur. Illa
Sed illa tantum haberi queunt in ortu
que ibi maris & fœminæ debita con-
si pauci a matre errores committantur,
debite non habeat, tum aut conceptio
non fit, aut abortus obvenit. Accedit,
sit, & jure naturæ obligetur se totum
velit commodare, talis quoque ipsi o-
rigo conveniat, qua & speciatim se Deo

page.notes: Printed text is in a roman face with long s rendered as plain s; "s" is retained as printed only in transcription conventions above. Some letters are damaged or blurred at the right edge (e.g., "nili" possibly "nisi"; "Accedit," and "Aristotele adduɆta" – the ligature "Ɇ" is a best reading of "adduɆta" = "adducta" and is doubtful). Signature "T 4" and catchword "eo" as read.
